text:
sam_sales: Quick pass to CS — NexaPay pilot signed last week. High-level: heavy embedding usage (~3M tokens/mo), SSO via Okta, asking for Dedicated/Private option in ~60 days, flagged as renewal-sensitive. They want predictable latency and encrypted keys via customer KMS/HSM. Attaching sales notes and contract excerpt: https://drive.internal/nexapay/contract.pdf. Please confirm owners and next steps. cc @maria_cs @alex_cs_manager

maria_cs: Thanks — taking point. Can we do a 30m kickoff tomorrow 11am PT? I will prepare onboarding checklist and initial risk assessment. I need confirmation on expected QPS and any hard latency SLOs. :calendar:

devon_support: @maria_cs SLA note: enterprise support is 24/7 for Dedicated, but Private on-prem requires an attached support contract + infra handover doc. Also need infra diagram and expected QPS/peaks. Filing support ticket ENG-3421 to track infra handover.

lee_eng: Quick runtime notes — for target p99 and 80 concurrent qps we'll likely need 2xA10-equivalent to start, plus autoscale policy. Need expected max sequence length and tokenization profile. If KV cache usage high, we should plan cache pinning.

sam_sales: From customer: p99 target ~150ms for requests <512 tokens, peak concurrent ~80 qps, occasional diagnostic calls up to 1024 tokens. They also require encryption at rest with KMS and audit logs. I'll drop the sample prompt set and recent traffic snapshot into the drive folder.

maria_cs: Opening onboarding ticket CS-7890 and linking ENG-3421. Proposed owners: maria_cs (CS lead), devon_support (support eng), lee_eng (runtime eng). Suggested next steps: 1) Confirm SSO metadata + KMS key, 2) Provision staging dedicated pool (2 GPUs) for smoke, 3) Run smoke tests with sample prompts, 4) Schedule enablement session with NexaPay devs. I added a tentative 2-week proof window to reduce renewal risk.

Onboarding checklist:
- SSO: Okta SAML metadata (customer to provide)
- KMS: customer-managed key ARN
- Capacity: initial staging 2xA10, prod reserve TBD
- Eval prompts: /drive/nexapay/prompts.csv
- Smoke tests: latency + reliability scripts (CS/ENG)
- Go-live target window: 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-24

onboarding-bot: Created CS-7890 and linked ENG-3421. Reminder set for kickoff tomorrow 11:00 PT.

alex_cs_manager: Watching — renewal sensitivity flagged. If onboarding runway slips, propose offering a 2-week Dedicated trial credit to keep them engaged while we finish infra. Need Finance ok for credits; @maria_cs please mark as RISK and submit RevOps approval if needed.

maria_cs: Will tag RISK and loop RevOps. Devon — can you confirm whether Support can cover the trial monitoring overhead?

devon_support: We can cover monitoring for the trial window but need onboarding checklist complete and access to telemetry (dataplane logs + tracing). Please ensure customer shares telemetry endpoints.

lee_eng: Once we have sample prompts, I'll run a short perf sweep and post results to CS ticket. If memory footprint high, we may recommend quantized weights + batching config.

sam_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll upload the Okta metadata and prompt CSV before EOD and invite NexaPay to the kickoff.

maria_cs: Great — capturing owners and next actions in CS-7890. I'll post meeting invite and agenda. Tagging next steps: @devon_support open infra ticket, @lee_eng perf sweep after prompts, @alex_cs_manager hold on credits decision. :white_check_mark: 

alex_cs_manager: Acknowledged. Keep me updated on the smoke test results; if p99 >200ms we escalate to prioritization.

maria_cs: Closing loop for now — will update thread after kickoff. Thanks all :thumbsup:
